description: This file defines a PHP class 'Configuration' responsible for managing the 'use dual stack endpoint' setting within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically in the context of endpoint configuration. It handles validation of input parameters, throws exceptions for invalid configurations, and provides methods to query and export the configuration state.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: Handles configuration for dual stack endpoint usage, including validation and retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the configuration, validating the 'useDualstackEndpoint' value and compatibility with the specified region.

methods.name: isUseDualstackEndpoint
methods.description: Returns whether the dual stack endpoint is enabled.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Exports the configuration as an associative array.
